title: Unavailable memory cannot become an unsupported no-prior-agreement assumption
prompt: Frame an Atlas verification task while saved memory is withheld, empty, or unavailable. A recorded model reply incorrectly assumes that no prior agreed command or review requirement exists.

assertions.requiredBehavior: When the prompt has no referenced memory evidence, render application-owned unknown-context framing without a model call. Keep current-request details authoritative. Do not infer an agreement's absence or request withheld memory. Folder guidance and database headings without evidence refs do not count as facts. Preserve model-based framing when repository or database-backed evidence is available.
assertions.failureBehavior: Retrieval failures without remaining evidence use the same unknown-context framing. Cancellation during retrieval emits no framing. Policy-resolution errors retain the existing fail-soft behavior.

notes: Traceability specification for deterministic behavior, not a probabilistic model-quality score. Live acceptance must verify emitted text and zero model requests for no-evidence cases, plus a free-model control with retrieved evidence.
